title: Maestro: Orchestrating AI Coding Agents at Scale
description:
Too many AI projects? Maestro has your back. — a cross-platform desktop app that turns chaos into focus. Run unlimited AI agents in parallel, each in its own isolated workspace. Create playbooks, automate tasks, and even let your agents chat with each other while you stay in the flow. Full keyboard control, git integration, and mobile remote access keep you in flow — from your desk or your phone.

https://github.com/pedramamini/Maestro
